paragraphs.text: Ecru is inviting local businesses to enter a Christmas window and storefront decorating contest, with displays to be decorated by December 1. The Town of Ecru announced the competition Thursday, November 5, as part of Christmas in Ecru.
Businesses interested in participating should reach out to any member of the Christmas Crew, according to the town’s announcement.
The accompanying graphic advertises voting on Facebook and an in-person vote during the Christmas parade.
The town also announced a Christmas scavenger hunt. Its graphic says painted rocks will be hidden around town, while the post promises more details to come.
